questions.text: Which app does Amir use to memorise English vocabulary?
questions.hint: "I use Anki — a spaced repetition app — to memorise English vocabulary."

questions.text: Amir always uses phone calls to communicate with friends.
questions.hint: "I rarely use phone calls anymore — I prefer texting."

questions.text: How many unread messages does Amir usually have by morning?
questions.hint: "I usually have about forty-seven unread messages by morning."

questions.text: Amir says he plans to start his better habits "starting next ___".
questions.hint: "Starting next Monday!" (he's joking about procrastinating).

questions.text: Amir's professor fully approves of his use of ChatGPT.
questions.hint: "My professor has mixed feelings about this."

questions.text: What percentage of students use Instagram?
questions.hint: "Instagram is the most popular platform, used by 87% of respondents."

questions.text: Telegram is used by choice — students can use other tools instead.
questions.hint: "Telegram is practically a compulsory tool for academic survival."

questions.text: What percentage of students want to use social media less?
questions.hint: "71% of students said they wanted to use social media less"

questions.text: "Digital literacy" means...
questions.hint: "digital literacy: the skill of using technology critically, purposefully"

questions.text: What is Rustam's first problem when he calls IT support?
questions.hint: "My laptop stopped working — the screen is completely black."

questions.text: What does the support agent ask Rustam to do first?
opts: Press and hold the power button for 10 seconds
questions.correct: Press and hold the power button for 10 seconds
questions.hint: "try pressing and holding the power button for ten seconds"

questions.text: Rustam saves his work to OneDrive.
questions.hint: "uploading to Google Drive" — Google Drive, not OneDrive.

questions.text: What backup solution does the support agent suggest?
questions.hint: "use your phone as a mobile hotspot as a backup"

questions.text: The support agent's name is ___.
questions.hint: "You're speaking with Daniyar."

questions.text: "I ___ check my phone first thing in the morning." (100% of the time)
questions.hint: always = 100% of the time. Position: before main verb.

questions.text: Correct: "She ___ is ___ late."
questions.hint: With "be": She IS always late. Adverb comes AFTER "be".

questions.text: "I check always my email" is correct.
questions.hint: Adverb BEFORE main verb: "I always check my email." ✅

questions.text: ___ she use LinkedIn for job searching? — Yes, she does.
questions.hint: She = 3rd person → Does she use? (base verb after does).

questions.text: "Does she uses Twitter?" — what is wrong?
questions.hint: After does/do → base form: Does she USE? (never "uses").

questions.text: "I want ___ reduce my screen time."
questions.hint: want → to + infinitive: I want to reduce.

questions.text: "I enjoy ___ programming tutorials."
questions.hint: enjoy → -ing: I enjoy watching.

questions.text: "She avoids ___ her phone in lectures."
questions.hint: avoid → -ing: She avoids using.

questions.text: He needs ___ (update) his graphics driver this week.
questions.hint: need → to + infinitive: He needs to update.

questions.text: "I like ___ music while I study." Which is correct?
questions.hint: like → both forms OK! I like to listen = I like listening.

questions.text: What does "screen time" mean?
opts: Amount of time spent looking at screens
questions.correct: Amount of time spent looking at screens
questions.hint: Screen time = total daily time spent on phones, laptops, tablets.

questions.text: A message or alert from an app on your phone is a ___.
questions.hint: Notification = an alert from an app.

questions.text: "Digital literacy" is...
questions.hint: Digital literacy = using technology with skill and critical thinking.

questions.text: "Intentional" means doing something by accident.
questions.hint: Intentional = done on purpose, with a clear goal in mind.

questions.text: What does "memorise" mean?
opts: Learn something so you can remember it perfectly
questions.correct: Learn something so you can remember it perfectly
questions.hint: Memorise = to learn something so well you can recall it exactly.

questions.text: What does "distract" mean?
opts: To take attention away from what you should be doing
questions.correct: To take attention away from what you should be doing
questions.hint: Distract = to take someone's attention away from their task.
